name: 3.2 Side by side, one after the other
description: Two empty diagrams: build f ⊗ g and g ∘ f and compare their ∘⊗ readings and Dirac forms.

exercise.title: Side by side, one after the other
exercise.statement:
In the diagram **f ⊗ g**, put two boxes f and g side by side, each on its own wire. In the diagram **g ∘ f** (choose it in the top panel's diagram menu), wire f's output into g's input, with g above f.

Tick **∘⊗** in the Diagram Editor's bar to see each diagram as layers composed in sequence, with pieces side by side in a layer. Then Generate each one in the Dirac Formula Editor (it follows the diagram chosen in its menu).
exercise.done: Generate gives $f \otimes g$ for the first and $g\,f$ for the second, and the ∘⊗ view shows one layer with a ⊗ in it, and two layers joined by ∘.
